entity: Generic makers Teva, Actavis and Mutual, as filers of lawyer-sourced metoclopramide reports
why: No usable source names Teva, Actavis or Mutual; all are about the drug: ISMP counts 4,237 lawsuit reports in 2011 Q2 and ranks metoclopramide 2011's most-litigated drug, RAPS says 65% of its reports through 2018 were lawyer-sourced. The headline's subject is the makers, so drug-level coverage is Known pattern under v3 (Drugwatch's 'entity yes' names the drug, not the makers).
